text: Anya (Design): quick follow-up from today's catalog review — i pushed a small figma update to experiment with a slimmer compare row (less vertical padding). feels better on 1280px but looks cramped on laptop screens >:thinking: Mike (PM): link? where in the file tree? can you show before/after with badges visible? :eyes: Anya (Design): https://figma.redwood/designs/compare-slim — under 'experiment/compact-rows'. before: 16px padding, badge size 20px. after: 8px padding, badge size unchanged. Sofia (Eng): i took a quick run rendering the compact rows in the dev branch. perf-wise no difference. main concern: truncation of model name + pinned version label on narrow widths. copy currently: "Pinned 1.3.2" — gets elided. Kevin (A11y): also flagged contrast on the "performance" badge — yellow on white fails WCAG 4.5:1. need to hit >=4.5 for small text. current hexs: #FFEA8A on #FFFFFF. suggestion: darken to #E0B700 or use a dark outline. Anya (Design): agreed. proposal: keep badge circular indicator but move textual score out to tooltip on hover for compact mode. visible UI would be a darker dot + accessible label for screen readers: Latency score: 72 ms Sofia (Eng): small nit — if we hide the score text in compact, keyboard users need a focusable element with aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip content. otherwise it's invisible to non-mouse users. Kevin (A11y): yes. recommend role="button" tabindex="0" on the dot and aria-label="Performance: 72 milliseconds, 3rd quartile". also add :focus outline and 3:1 contrast for the focus ring. Anya (Design): copy tweak ideas for pin UX. current label "Pinned" feels ambiguous. alternatives: "Pinned to version" or "Active pin: 1.3.2". which reads better? Mike (PM): prefer concise but explicit: "Pinned to 1.3.2" — because teams look for which exact version. Sofia (Eng): backend note — our current pin object only stores version string; adding "pinned_by" is cheap. if we change label to include version we can show it without extra api calls. Anya (Design): ok i'll update mocks to show "Pinned to 1.3.2" and collapse the label in compact mode to just the version pill. design-bot: Deployed preview: /deploys/pr-4282 — test on mobile widths 360/412 and laptop 1366. Mike (PM): question about filter persistence: when switching between compare rows, filters clear. expected: persist during session. is that planned? Sofia (Eng): not currently persisted across routes. easy to add session storage keyed by catalog route. downside: stale filters when switching product contexts. propose scoping key by org + catalog view. Anya (Design): UX ask — if filters persist, add a subtle "filters applied" chip with an x to clear quickly. also consider a keyboard shortcut to reset filters ("f r"). Kevin (A11y): ensure chip has aria-live region updates when counts change. screen reader users should get announcements for "3 filters applied". Sofia (Eng): i'll prototype sessionStorage + aria updates in the branch. small CSS snippet i'm testing: ```css .compact-row { padding: 8px 10px; } .compare-badge { height: 18px; width: 18px; border-radius: 9px; } .pinned-pill { background: #F3F5F7; color: #111827; padding: 4px 6px; border-radius: 6px; } ``` Anya (Design): looks good. last thing: ordering of action buttons in the row — currently we show [Compare] [Pin] [More]. designers prefer primary action first (Compare), then Pin, then More. engineers mentioned that Pin is destructive? need to confirm if pinning should be reversible without modal. Mike (PM): pin is not destructive. it is reversible. we should make it single-click toggle with snackbar undo for accidental pins. Sofia (Eng): implemented toggle in branch but added confirmation on bulk pins. single-row toggle will be instant + undo toast. Kevin (A11y): toast must be focusable and move focus when announced. ensure keyboard users can undo within toast via an actionable link. Anya (Design): great. i'll update the PR description and push the compact row mock with updated badge color and pin copy. want to ship the compact opt-in behind a feature flag first so we can measure click-throughs and any discoverability regressions. Mike (PM): works for me. set feature flag name and i'll coordinate a small experiment. Sofia (Eng): flag name: catalog_compact_rows_v1. i'll include rollout instructions in PR. Anya (Design): thanks all :thumbsup: leaving a checklist in the figma file and adding accessibility notes. Mike (PM): awesome — moving to epic backlog, tag me on the PR. :rocket:
